title: Leisure
scene: Early 1990s UK shoegaze and baggy/Madchester crossover
notes: Shoegaze guitars and baggy rhythms precede their later British-pop songwriting.

title: Modern Life Is Rubbish
scene: British post-baggy guitar pop / early Britpop
notes: Observational British character sketches replace hazy baggy textures with inventive guitar pop.

title: Parklife
notes: Eclectic social satire moves between guitar pop, disco, spoken sketches and strings.

title: The Great Escape
scene: 1990s British Britpop, suburban satire and orchestrated pop
sounds_like: The Kinks|XTC|Scott Walker|Fun Boy Three|The Divine Comedy
notes: Bright melodies and lavish instrumentation conceal dark portraits of suburban isolation.

title: Blur
scene: British post-Britpop and US-influenced alternative/indie rock
notes: Raw guitars, stripped-back songs and noise experiments dismantle the earlier Britpop template.

scene: Experimental late-1990s British art rock and electronica
notes: Disintegrating guitars, edited improvisations and gospel voices frame intensely vulnerable breakup songs.

title: Think Tank
scene: Post-Britpop electronic rock with Moroccan recording influences
notes: Loop-driven rock and Moroccan arrangements replace most of Coxon’s guitar with restless textures.

title: The Magic Whip
scene: Hong Kong-initiated reunion; British alternative rock and art-pop
notes: Hong Kong improvisations evolve into wistful synth-shaded guitar songs and distant-city sketches.
